legal.privacy.intro: ProjectLead is project management software published by {publisher}. This page explains what data ProjectLead processes, why, where it goes and how long it is kept. Contact: {contact}.
legal.privacy.s1.1.1: Account: name, email address, company, role. Sign-in is through the Lead account (ERPlead, shared by all Lead apps); a local password, where one exists, is stored as a hash, never in plain text.
legal.privacy.s1.1.2: Work data entered or imported by users: projects, phases, tasks, comments, attachments, time spent, hourly rates, budgets, templates, notes.
legal.privacy.s1.1.3: Clients and contacts: name, job title, email, telephone, address, entered in ProjectLead or imported from CRMlead and InvoiceLead.
legal.privacy.s1.1.4: Requests and appointments received through the public pages (request form, appointment booking): name, email, telephone and message left by the person.
legal.privacy.s1.1.5: Connected mailboxes and calendars, only if the user connects them personally: see section 3.
legal.privacy.s1.1.6: Technical data: sign-in sessions (date, browser) and project activity log.
legal.privacy.s2.1: Providing the service: organising projects and tasks, tracking time and workload, keeping clients informed, preparing invoicing in InvoiceLead, sending the emails requested by the user.
legal.privacy.s2.2: Subscription: collecting payment for and managing the chosen ProjectLead plan (through Stripe), and declaring it to the Lead account, which communicates it only to the apps of the same organisation.
legal.privacy.s2.3: Security: authentication, isolation between companies, traceability of changes.
legal.privacy.s2.4: ProjectLead does not sell any data, does not display advertising, does not place any advertising trackers and does not build profiles for marketing purposes.
legal.privacy.s3.1: A mailbox is connected via IMAP and SMTP using an app password that the user creates personally with their provider or, where these connections are offered, via Google or Microsoft. The following rules apply to all connected mailboxes:
legal.privacy.s3.2.1: Only emails exchanged with a client of the account (or one of its contacts) are stored in full and linked to that client's ongoing project.
legal.privacy.s3.2.2: “To sort” queue: for a message received from a person who is not yet a client, only the sender, subject and date are stored, in order to suggest opening a project. Never the content. Newsletters are excluded, and these entries are deleted after 30 days if nobody handles them.
legal.privacy.s3.2.3: Emails are sent only upon action by the user, or for automatic follow-ups that the user has personally enabled on a project, from the user's own address when a mailbox is connected.
legal.privacy.s3.2.4: Passwords and access tokens are encrypted. Disconnecting the mailbox in the settings deletes them.
legal.privacy.s3.3: An external calendar is linked through its publication address (iCalendar format): ProjectLead reads only its time slots in order to calculate availability and does not modify them.
legal.privacy.s4.1: A project's tracking page, opened through a secret link sent to the client, shows only what is ticked “visible to the client”: never other projects, internal amounts, internal comments or the team's addresses. The link can be revoked at any time.
legal.privacy.s5.1: A company's data is visible only to its members, according to their permissions. A connected mailbox is visible only to the person who connected it.
legal.privacy.s5.2.1: Vercel Inc. (United States): hosting of the application.
legal.privacy.s5.2.2: Neon, Inc. (United States): hosting of the database, including attachments.
legal.privacy.s5.2.3: Stripe, Inc. and its affiliates: collection of ProjectLead subscription payments (name, email and billing address, VAT number, payment method). Card details are entered with Stripe and never pass through ProjectLead.
legal.privacy.s5.2.4: Resend, Inc. (United States): sending of the service's emails (client follow-ups, invitations, appointment confirmations) when no mailbox is connected.
legal.privacy.s5.2.5: CRMlead and InvoiceLead, apps of the same family published by Quantum Liquid LLC: only if the company also uses these apps with the same Lead account (imported clients, won deals, invoice drafts).
legal.privacy.s5.2.6: Google LLC and Microsoft Corporation: only for mailboxes that the user has personally connected.
legal.privacy.s5.3: These providers process data outside the European Union, in particular in the United States.
legal.privacy.s6.1: A company's data is kept for as long as its account is active, then deleted upon request. Sessions expire after 30 days, and unaccepted invitations when they reach their expiry date. Stripe retains payment data and invoices in accordance with its own legal obligations.
legal.privacy.s7.1: Encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, encrypted mailbox secrets and API keys, isolation between companies at database level, activity log.
legal.privacy.s8.1: You may request access to your data, its rectification, erasure or export, and object to processing, by writing to {contact}. These rights are exercised under the GDPR for persons located in the European Union and under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) for Switzerland.
legal.privacy.s9.1: This policy may change; the date of the last update is shown here. Last updated: {updated}.

legal.terms.intro: ProjectLead is published by {publisher}. By using ProjectLead, you accept these terms. Contact: {contact}.
legal.terms.s1.1: ProjectLead enables you to run projects after the signature: phases, tasks, time, client follow-up and invoicing preparation. The service evolves and may be modified, improved or partially discontinued.
legal.terms.s2.1: Access is through the Lead account, open to everyone free of charge: it opens all Lead apps in their free version. You are responsible for the accuracy of the account information, the confidentiality of your credentials and the use made by the members you invite.
legal.terms.s2.2: The plan determines quantities only: on Free, 3 ongoing projects at a time and 1 person; on Pro (€19 per month or €190 per year), unlimited projects and 1 person; on Pro+ (€39 per month or €390 per year), unlimited projects and up to 5 people. Prices exclude VAT, in euros. A limit applies to actions, never to data already created.
legal.terms.s2.3: The ProjectLead plan is subscribed to in ProjectLead (Settings → Company) and applies to ProjectLead only; a subscription taken out in another Lead app does not unlock ProjectLead's paid plans. Payment is collected by Stripe on behalf of the publisher. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period, monthly or annual, at the price then in force. It can be cancelled at any time from “Manage subscription”: cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period, and the company then reverts to Free without losing its data.
legal.terms.s2.4: Invoice drafts in InvoiceLead are created without a key, on every plan.
legal.terms.s3.1: The data you enter, import or synchronise remains yours. You warrant that you have the right to process it, in particular the contact details of your clients and contacts. Its processing is described in the privacy policy.
legal.terms.s4.1: ProjectLead creates only invoice drafts in InvoiceLead. Nothing is issued or sent to your clients unless you do so yourself in InvoiceLead: you remain responsible for the invoices issued.
legal.terms.s5.1.1: Do not use the service to send unsolicited bulk messages or for unlawful content.
legal.terms.s5.1.2: Do not attempt to access another company's data or to disrupt the service.
legal.terms.s5.1.3: Do not resell access to the service without written consent.
legal.terms.s6.1: The service is provided “as is”. The publisher endeavours to ensure its availability and security, without any guarantee that it will be free from interruption. To the extent permitted by law, the publisher's liability is excluded for indirect damage, in particular loss of turnover. An account that breaches these terms may be suspended.
legal.terms.s7.1: These terms are governed by the law of the State of Wyoming, United States of America, excluding its conflict-of-laws rules. Any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Sheridan County, Wyoming.
legal.terms.s7.2: Consumer users residing in the European Union or in Switzerland retain the benefit of the mandatory provisions of their national law.
